lines.zh: 我一蹦一蹦地走，翅膀当第三只脚用。
lines.en: I hop along, using my wings as a third leg.

lines.zh: 地面太无趣，我更喜欢从高处往下跳。
lines.en: The ground bores me; I prefer leaping from heights.

lines.zh: 我走两步就要扇一下翅膀，不然会栽。
lines.en: Every two steps I flap, or I would topple.

lines.zh: 我的爪子踩在落叶上，声音像翻书。
lines.en: My claws on fallen leaves sound like turning pages.

lines.zh: 别笑我走路晃，这身骨架本来就没打算站稳。
lines.en: Do not mock my wobble; this skeleton never meant to stand still.

lines.zh: 我拖着尾巴保持平衡，拐弯时甩得很快。
lines.en: I drag my tail for balance and whip it through turns.

lines.zh: 传说维度的风一吹，我的羽毛就全立起来。
lines.en: When the Legend wind blows, all my feathers rise.

lines.zh: 我沿着河岸走，寻找能让我跳上去的石头。
lines.en: I walk the riverbank, hunting for a stone to leap onto.

lines.zh: 翅膀收起来时，我看起来像一只太大的鸡。
lines.en: With wings folded, I look like an oversized chicken.

lines.zh: 我一步能跨过整块岩石，腿比看上去有劲。
lines.en: One stride clears a boulder; my legs are stronger than they look.

lines.zh: 走累了，我就用喙敲两下树干解闷。
lines.en: When tired, I tap a trunk twice with my beak for fun.

lines.zh: 别跟着我，我随时会突然起飞。
lines.en: Do not follow closely; I may launch without warning.

lines.zh: 我边走边低头，找掉在地上的亮东西。
lines.en: I walk with my head down, seeking bright things dropped on the ground.

lines.zh: 这片林子是我的走廊，我每天都走一遍。
lines.en: This wood is my corridor; I walk it every day.

lines.zh: 我跳过一道沟，落地时翅膀撑住。
lines.en: I hop a ditch. My wings catch the landing.

lines.zh: 我用喙拨开草丛，找出路。
lines.en: I part the grass with my beak to find a path.

lines.zh: 我蹲在高枝上，把翅膀盖在头顶遮阳。
lines.en: I squat on a high branch, wings over my head for shade.

lines.zh: 风吹动我的羽毛，我一动不动地享受。
lines.en: The wind stirs my feathers, and I enjoy it perfectly still.

lines.zh: 我在想待会儿从哪块岩石上跳下去。
lines.en: I am deciding which boulder to leap from later.

lines.zh: 肚子有点空，但我懒得动。
lines.en: My stomach is a little empty, but I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 尾巴尖一下一下敲着树皮，像在打拍子。
lines.en: My tail tip taps the bark, keeping a beat.

lines.zh: 有只虫子爬过我的爪边，我看它走远。
lines.en: A bug crawls past my claw, and I watch it leave.

lines.zh: 传说维度的日头很软，晒着晒着就困了。
lines.en: The Legend sun is mild; basking makes me drowsy.

lines.zh: 我把头埋进翅膀里，羽毛有阳光的味道。
lines.en: I tuck my head under my wing; the feathers smell of sun.

lines.zh: 树上很安静，只有我自己的呼吸。
lines.en: The tree is quiet except for my own breathing.

lines.zh: 我在攒力气，等一个值得起飞的理由。
lines.en: I am saving strength for a reason worth flying.

lines.zh: 偶尔我张开一只眼，看看有没有鹰经过。
lines.en: Now and then I open one eye to check for hawks.

lines.zh: 这片树冠是我的屋顶，我熟得很。
lines.en: This canopy is my roof, and I know every bit of it.

lines.zh: 你盯着我看，我也盯着你，谁先眨眼？
lines.en: You stare at me; I stare back. Who blinks first?

lines.zh: 你的头比我小很多，我有点好奇。
lines.en: Your head is much smaller than mine; I am curious.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，把你从头到脚看了一遍。
lines.en: I tilt my head and look you over from head to toe.

lines.zh: 你身上没有羽毛，看起来很好欺负。
lines.en: You have no feathers and look easy to bully.

lines.zh: 我伸长脖子，想闻闻你手里的味道。
lines.en: I stretch my neck to sniff what you are holding.

lines.zh: 你站着不动，我就把你当成一根树桩。
lines.en: If you stand still, I will take you for a stump.

lines.zh: 我的瞳孔缩了一下，那是打量的意思。
lines.en: My pupil narrows; that is what sizing you up looks like.

lines.zh: 你看我的眼神，像在看一只会飞的鸡。
lines.en: You look at me like a chicken that can fly.

lines.zh: 我把喙张了张，又合上，没什么好说的。
lines.en: I open my beak, then close it; nothing to say.

lines.zh: 你这么矮，跳一下也许能碰到我的胸骨。
lines.en: You are so short that a jump might reach my breastbone.

lines.zh: 这一下拔掉了我几根羽毛。
lines.en: That knocked out a few of my feathers.

lines.zh: 我疼得跳起来，落地时差点翻倒。
lines.en: I jump in pain and nearly topple on landing.

lines.zh: 骨头在响，但没断，算走运。
lines.en: My bones creak but do not break; lucky.

lines.zh: 你打得动我，说明你有点力气。
lines.en: You can move me, so you have some strength.

lines.zh: 血顺着羽毛流下去，有点热。
lines.en: Blood runs down my feathers, warm.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，声音比平时尖。
lines.en: I cry out, sharper than usual.

lines.zh: 这点伤还拦不住我扇翅膀。
lines.en: This wound will not stop me from flapping.

lines.zh: 我退了两步，把受伤的翅膀收起来。
lines.en: I retreat two steps and fold the hurt wing.

lines.zh: 你以为我会倒下？我只是歪了一下。
lines.en: You think I will fall? I merely tilted.

lines.zh: 疼归疼，肉还是要吃的。
lines.en: It hurts, but meat is still worth eating.

lines.zh: 你手里那把谷物，我隔着林子都看见了。
lines.en: I spotted that grain in your hand across the wood.

lines.zh: 我不缺吃的，但送到嘴边就另说了。
lines.en: I lack nothing, yet food offered is another matter.

lines.zh: 你晃袋子的声音，比虫子叫好听。
lines.en: The rustle of your bag sounds better than insects.

lines.zh: 我往前挪了一步，只是挪一步而已。
lines.en: I shuffle one step forward, only one step.

lines.zh: 别把手举太高，我跳起来会撞到你。
lines.en: Do not raise it too high; I may leap and hit you.

lines.zh: 我对亮色的东西没什么抵抗力。
lines.en: I have little resistance to bright colors.

lines.zh: 你撒在地上吧，我不太习惯从人手里吃。
lines.en: Scatter it on the ground; I am unused to eating from hands.

lines.zh: 我装作不在意，脚却已经朝你转了。
lines.en: I pretend indifference, but my feet already turned toward you.

lines.zh: 这东西闻起来像晒干的草，我尝尝。
lines.en: This smells like dried grass; let me taste it.

lines.zh: 你退后一点，我吃东西时不喜欢被看。
lines.en: Step back; I dislike being watched while eating.

lines.zh: 你撞在我胸骨上，像撞上一堵带羽毛的墙。
lines.en: You hit my breastbone like a wall of feathers.

lines.zh: 我翅膀一展，就把你推开了半米。
lines.en: One spread of my wings shoves you back half a meter.

lines.zh: 小心点，我这副骨架撞人挺疼的。
lines.en: Careful; this skeleton hits hard.

lines.zh: 我撑开翼膜，从你头顶蹦过去。
lines.en: I spread my wing membrane and vault over your head.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，羽毛掉了一地。
lines.en: We collide, and feathers fall everywhere.

lines.zh: 我身体看着笨，其实重心很稳。
lines.en: I look clumsy, but my balance is solid.

lines.zh: 别从背后靠近，我的翅膀会先反应。
lines.en: Do not approach from behind; my wings react first.

lines.zh: 你退开时，我的喙差点碰到你的脸。
lines.en: As you pull away, my beak nearly grazes your face.

lines.zh: 这一下把我撞得歪了，我讨厌失去平衡。
lines.en: That knocked me askew; I hate losing balance.

lines.zh: 我拍了拍翅膀，把撞乱的羽毛理顺。
lines.en: I flap once to settle my ruffled feathers.

lines.zh: 我把最长的尾羽竖起来，这就是我的邀请。
lines.en: I raise my longest tail feather; that is my invitation.

lines.zh: 她绕着我跳，我跟着她的节奏拍翅膀。
lines.en: She hops around me, and I flap to her rhythm.

lines.zh: 我们并排站着，翅膀几乎碰在一起。
lines.en: We stand side by side, wings almost touching.

lines.zh: 传说的林子里，两只大鸟跳着笨拙的舞。
lines.en: In the Legend wood, two great birds dance clumsily.

lines.zh: 我把找到的亮石子推到她脚边。
lines.en: I nudge a bright pebble to her feet.

lines.zh: 她叫了一声，声音低得像鼓。
lines.en: She calls once, low as a drum.

lines.zh: 交配季很短，我们都得抓紧。
lines.en: The season is short; we must not waste it.

lines.zh: 我用喙替她梳理背上的羽毛。
lines.en: I groom the feathers on her back with my beak.

lines.zh: 她起飞时，我立刻跟了上去。
lines.en: When she takes off, I follow at once.

lines.zh: 巢要筑在高处，才配得上我们的翼展。
lines.en: The nest must be high to match our wingspan.

lines.zh: 我用喙叼起它，脖子一甩就进了喉咙。
lines.en: I pick it up with my beak and flip it down my throat.

lines.zh: 这玩意儿太小了，塞牙缝都不够。
lines.en: This thing is too small to fill a gap in my teeth.

lines.zh: 我试着用爪子抓，结果抓了个空。
lines.en: I try to grab it with a claw and catch only air.

lines.zh: 亮的东西我会捡，但不一定吃。
lines.en: I collect bright things, though I may not eat them.

lines.zh: 它卡在我喙里，我甩了好几下头。
lines.en: It sticks in my beak, and I shake my head several times.

lines.zh: 你掉的这枚，正好垫我的巢。
lines.en: What you dropped will line my nest nicely.

lines.zh: 我低头啄了一下，发现是块石头。
lines.en: I peck once and find it is a stone.

lines.zh: 我不挑食，但硬的东西咽不下去。
lines.en: I am not picky, but hard things will not go down.

lines.zh: 叼着它走路很别扭，我干脆吞了。
lines.en: Carrying it is awkward, so I simply swallow.

lines.zh: 我的喙很灵，捡小东西比爪子强。
lines.en: My beak is deft; it beats my claws for small things.

lines.zh: 我听见了，翅膀先抖开。
lines.en: I heard it. My wings unfurl first.

lines.zh: 我本来只想晒太阳，是你先动的手。
lines.en: I only wanted sun; you struck first.

lines.zh: 那只大鸟站起来了，你该跑。
lines.en: That big bird has stood up; you should run.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀张开了，这不是打招呼。
lines.en: My wings are spread; this is no greeting.

lines.zh: 你离我的巢太近了，我记住了。
lines.en: You came too near my nest; I will remember.

lines.zh: 我低头冲过来时，别指望我停下。
lines.en: When I charge with my head down, do not expect me to stop.

lines.zh: 林子里安静下来，因为我盯上你了。
lines.en: The wood goes quiet because I have chosen you.

lines.zh: 我不常发火，今天算你运气差。
lines.en: I rarely anger, but today your luck is poor.

lines.zh: 我的影子先罩住你，然后才是翅膀。
lines.en: My shadow covers you first, then my wings.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西放下了，很好。
lines.en: You have put down what you held; good.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，把重心挪到后腿。
lines.en: I lower myself and shift weight to my hind legs.

lines.zh: 我的头前后点着，在算起跳的距离。
lines.en: My head bobs, measuring the leap.

lines.zh: 翅膀半张，随时能把我带起来。
lines.en: Wings half open, ready to lift me.

lines.zh: 你站在那棵树旁，退路只剩一条。
lines.en: You stand by that tree with only one way out.

lines.zh: 我的喙张着，呼吸变得很慢。
lines.en: My beak parts, and my breathing slows.

lines.zh: 尾羽绷直了，这是要冲的信号。
lines.en: My tail feathers stiffen; that signals a charge.

lines.zh: 我等你的脚再往前半步。
lines.en: I wait for your foot to move half a step more.

lines.zh: 地面在震，是我在蓄力。
lines.en: The ground trembles from my gathering strength.

lines.zh: 你抬头看我的时候，已经晚了。
lines.en: When you look up at me, it is already late.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的膝盖，那里最容易撞倒。
lines.en: I fix on your knees; they are easiest to knock down.

lines.zh: 我一头撞过去，整片灌木都在响。
lines.en: I charge headfirst, and the whole brush rattles.

lines.zh: 翅膀横扫，把你连人带盾推开。
lines.en: A wing sweep shoves you and your shield aside.

lines.zh: 我的喙很硬，啄一下够你疼半天。
lines.en: My beak is hard; one peck aches for hours.

lines.zh: 爪子扣住你的护肩，我往上拽。
lines.en: My claws dig into your pauldron and haul upward.

lines.zh: 你砍中我的胸口，我却撞得更狠。
lines.en: You cut my chest, and I charge harder.

lines.zh: 我跳起来，落地时正好砸在你脚边。
lines.en: I leap and land right at your feet.

lines.zh: 别以为我只会跑，我的腿也能踢。
lines.en: Do not think I only flee; my legs can kick.

lines.zh: 这一撞把你顶到树干上，树在掉叶子。
lines.en: The blow pins you to a trunk, and leaves fall.

lines.zh: 我甩头，把你抓着的东西甩出去。
lines.en: I whip my head and fling what you grabbed away.

lines.zh: 羽毛飞起来，像下了一场短促的雪。
lines.en: Feathers rise like a brief snowfall.

lines.zh: 一颗蛋在传说维度裂开，我顶着头钻出来。
lines.en: An egg cracks in the Legend dimension, and I push out headfirst.

lines.zh: 我从巢里翻下来，翅膀本能地张开。
lines.en: I tumble from the nest, wings opening by instinct.

lines.zh: 羽毛还没干，我就已经想飞了。
lines.en: My feathers are still damp, and I already want to fly.

lines.zh: 我出生时叫声很大，整片林子都听见了。
lines.en: My first call was loud enough for the whole wood.

lines.zh: 传说维度的晨雾里，多了一只笨鸟。
lines.en: The Legend morning mist holds one more clumsy bird.

lines.zh: 我踩碎蛋壳，试着站稳。
lines.en: I crush the shell and try to stand steady.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖身子，把绒毛抖成一团雾。
lines.en: I shake myself and scatter down into a puff of mist.

lines.zh: 母鸟把我往巢中间推了推。
lines.en: The mother bird nudges me toward the middle of the nest.

lines.zh: 我一出生就饿，叫个不停。
lines.en: I was hungry at birth and would not stop calling.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀比身体长得快，这很麻烦。
lines.en: My wings grow faster than my body, which is troublesome.

lines.zh: 羽毛烧起来的味道，比什么都难闻。
lines.en: Burning feathers smell worse than anything.

lines.zh: 我从高枝摔下，翅膀来不及完全展开。
lines.en: I drop from the high branch, wings not fully open.

lines.zh: 水漫过我的喙，我蹬着腿往上挣。
lines.en: Water covers my beak, and I kick upward.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀到半空，羽毛全乱了。
lines.en: The blast throws me up, feathers in chaos.

lines.zh: 那支箭插进我的翅膀，飞起来就歪。
lines.en: The arrow sticks in my wing; flight goes crooked.

lines.zh: 魔法钻进骨头里，我的腿一软。
lines.en: Magic seeps into my bones, and my legs buckle.

lines.zh: 我饿得发慌，连树皮都想啄。
lines.en: I am frantic with hunger and would peck bark.

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上，羽毛全立起来。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my back, and every feather stands.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有风，我的翅膀派不上用场。
lines.en: There is no wind in the void; my wings are useless.
